doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Jobim CD and label with John Lee
summary: Slide Hampton Plays Jobim was made in John Lee's South Orange studio; Hampton paid for it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: What’s the name of the project?
It’s called Slide Hampton Plays Jobim . . .
. . . a tribute to Antonio Carlos Jobim.
And on what label is it? This is John’s label?
That’s our label. It’s a production of John and I.
You did it in his studio?
Is that your first – is it the first project with him?
First one with him. It’s not the first one that I’ve done. I’ve done another project where I produced the record too. I paid for it. I paid for both of these.
But it’s the first project in John’s studio that you are doing.
And it’s a label that you have together?
Yeah. It was just for this one CD.
